name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 27 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2025-10-06, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.46 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
